The vendor directly providing the software product **Suki** at **suki.ai** is **Suki AI, Inc.**

> *"These Terms of Service (this “Agreement”) are entered into by and between Suki AI, Inc., a Delaware corporation (“Suki”), and the entity or person accessing or using the Suki Platform (“Customer”)."*

The site footer also states:
> *"© Copyright 2026. Suki AI, Inc. All rights reserved. The Suki name and logo are trademarks of Suki AI, Inc."*
